sources.snippet: Overview control_v11p_sd15_openpose is a ControlNet model that guides Stable Diffusion v1.5 image generation using human pose keypoints extracted from reference images. Built by lllyasviel, this model learns spatial conditioning from OpenPose skeleton data, enabling pose-controlled image synthesis without fine-tuning the base diffusion model.
